lines: // ESP32 From Zero - Episode 10: Reflex Game 2.0 (OLED screen + buzzer, the record survives unplugging)
// Parts: 0.96" I2C OLED (SSD1306, address 0x3C): SDA -> GPIO 21, SCL -> GPIO 22, VCC -> 3V3, GND -> GND

// Libraries: "Adafruit SSD1306" (Library Manager installs "Adafruit GFX" and "Adafruit BusIO" with it).
// How to play: press to start. Wait... the screen says GO! and beeps: press as fast as you can.
